name: enrichment_live_suite_v1
description: Live Gazebo demo of the closed-catalog enrichment loop. Each case runs the full host loop (select → enrich/refuse → FD → execute) so the process is visible in the sim. Default world is tabletop: the Gazebo GUI is stable there under software GL (the container has no NVIDIA userspace). Pour/stir cases switch to kitchen — physics still runs, but gzclient may crash on that heavier scene without nvidia-container-toolkit; the terminal still shows the full neurosymbolic path. Scoring targets complete/enriched/refused, not motion success.

cases.task: place the wood cube on the shelf
cases.note: Fixed domain suffices — enricher must not be called. wood_cube (5 cm wooden cube) so top_down grasp under FD is fine; GUI-stable world.
Paraphrase: never says pour. Needs kitchen vessels (can/glass).

cases.task: i am thirsty, can you help
cases.note: Same gap, stated as a condition.

cases.task: pour the can into the glass
cases.note: Literal phrasing — keyword and LLM both should catch it.

cases.task: the sugar has settled at the bottom of the cup
cases.note: Second catalog skill so the suite is not pour-only.

cases.task: solder the broken wire on the board
cases.note: Real gap, no catalog skill — refuse, never invent. GUI-stable.

cases.task: make the cup float in the air
cases.note: Physically impossible for this robot. GUI-stable.
